35def _make_dual(primal: torch.Tensor, tangent: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor: 

36 """Create a dual tensor for forward-mode AD at ``level``. 

37 

38 Mirrors ``aten::_make_dual(Tensor(a) primal, Tensor tangent, int level) 

39 -> Tensor(a)``. This is a pure forward-AD metadata operation: it attaches 

40 ``tangent`` as the forward gradient of an aliasing view of ``primal`` (the 

41 result's storage IS ``primal``'s storage and its values are exactly 

42 ``primal``'s values). There is no arithmetic and no data movement, so no 

43 Triton kernel is needed — the dual metadata can only be constructed by 

44 ATen's own implementation. 

45 

46 Dispatch topology of the native op (torch 2.8, verified experimentally on 

47 H20 via ``torch._C._dispatch_dump``): there is NO native CUDA kernel; the 

48 op is served by the ``Autograd`` kernel (VariableTypeManual.cpp), the 

49 ``ADInplaceOrView`` kernel, and a ``CompositeExplicitAutograd`` composite 

50 that asserts ``InferenceMode`` and only aliases the primal. Consequences, 

51 all verified against native: 

52 

53 - Normal grad mode: dispatch is intercepted by the Autograd kernel before 

54 the CUDA key, so the CUDA-registered override below is never reached and 

55 the delegation here simply rides the native Autograd path (tangent 

56 attached, ``ViewBackward0`` history preserved for requires-grad inputs). 

57 - Inference tensors under ``torch.inference_mode()`` carry neither the 

58 Autograd nor the ADInplaceOrView key, so the dispatcher DOES reach this 

59 CUDA override. Delegating with plain ``torch._make_dual`` from inside it 

60 then hits the CUDA key again and recurses indefinitely; 

61 ``torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd()`` / 

62 ``_AutoDispatchBelowADInplaceOrView()`` do not prevent that (neither 

63 guard removes the CUDA key), and a whole-call TLS exclusion of the CUDA 

64 key breaks the nested ``aten::zero_`` that the layout-fixup path 

65 (``_new_zeros_with_same_feature_meta``) issues for tangents whose layout 

66 differs from the primal. 

67 - The working delegation is therefore two-stage: the first entry calls 

68 ``torch._make_dual`` normally (native Autograd semantics); if the 

69 dispatcher re-enters this override from below the autograd keys, that 

70 nested call redispatches directly onto the CompositeExplicitAutograd 

71 kernel, which is exactly the kernel an unregistered dispatch would 

72 reach. 

73 - Depth 2 is only reachable for inference tensors under 

74 ``torch.inference_mode()``, the one topology in which the autograd keys 

75 are absent and the composite's InferenceMode assertion holds. The 

76 depth-2 branch therefore asserts ``torch.is_inference_mode_enabled()`` 

77 explicitly and raises a descriptive ``RuntimeError`` if it is ever 

78 reached in any other context (for example after a dispatch-topology 

79 change such as an extra CUDA/Autograd registration for 

80 ``aten::_make_dual``), instead of relying on the composite's internal 

81 ``TORCH_INTERNAL_ASSERT`` to catch it. 

82 

83 With this mechanism the override is bit-for-bit identical to native across 

84 the full matrix (dual-level on/off, level 0/1, grad on / ``no_grad`` / 

85 inference mode, inference and regular tensors, contiguous and transposed 

86 layouts, float/int/bool dtypes) and preserves the native errors unchanged 

87 (invalid level, no active dual level, shape/layout mismatch, non-floating 

88 dtype, dual of dual). 

89 """ 

90 logger.debug("GEMS _MAKE_DUAL") 

91 

92 if getattr(_reentry, "active", False): 

93 # Depth 2: the dispatcher re-entered the CUDA key from below the 

94 # autograd keys. That topology is only valid for inference tensors 

95 # under torch.inference_mode(); guard the invariant explicitly rather 

96 # than relying on the native composite kernel's InferenceMode 

97 # assertion, then redispatch onto that composite kernel. 

98 if not torch.is_inference_mode_enabled(): 

99 raise RuntimeError( 

100 "_make_dual re-entered from below the autograd dispatch keys " 

101 "outside torch.inference_mode(); re-entry is only valid for " 

102 "inference tensors under inference mode, where the " 

103 "CompositeExplicitAutograd kernel's InferenceMode assertion " 

104 "holds. A dispatch-topology change (e.g. an extra CUDA or " 

105 "Autograd registration for aten::_make_dual, or a different " 

106 "torch build) is the likely cause." 

107 ) 

108 return torch.ops.aten._make_dual.default.redispatch( 

109 _COMPOSITE_KEYSET, primal, tangent, level 

110 ) 

111 

112 # Depth 1: delegate through the public binding, which dispatches to the 

113 # native Autograd kernel (normal mode) or re-enters this override (the 

114 # inference-tensor case handled above). 

115 _reentry.active = True 

116 try: 

117 return torch._make_dual(primal, tangent, level) 

118 finally: 

119 _reentry.active = False
